messages.subject: Indigo - first draft licence for your review
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

First full draft of the Technology Licence and Development Collaboration Agreement attached (v1, clean). It's the long-form: grant, exclusivity, fees/milestones, royalties with audit, the collaboration/IP-ownership clause, warranties, IP indemnity, liability cap, and the nine schedules including the patent schedule and milestone schedule. Figures tie to the heads of terms. Grateful for a review before it goes to Pemberton Rowe.

Elena
